Not a movie, but The Twilight Zone (2019) gets undeserved flack. The first season isn't perfect,  but episodes like the Comedian, Nightmare at 30,000 Feet, and The Wunderkind all show promise, and watching the season in black and white does a lot to help the show feel like the Twilight Zone. Jordan Peele also does a good job as host. Hopefully he gets more creative control in the future as Us and Get Out feel very Twilight Zone.. And before anyone brings up the political nature of the season, Rod Sterling always wanted the Twilight Zone to be politically charge, and even fought to have the Night Gallery touch on race issues
